name: Spicy Umami Gimlet

ingredients.name: Truffles On The Rocks Umami Lime Cordial

instructions: For the sesame-washed gin, combine 500 ml Empress 1908 Cucumber Lemon Gin with 5 ml sesame oil and let infuse. Once the oil separates, freeze until solid, then strain through a fine mesh strainer.
For the chili oil garnish, pour 150 ml hot neutral oil over 2 tablespoons chili flakes and let infuse until back to room temperature.
Add the gin and cordial to a shaker with ice and roll until thoroughly chilled.
Strain into a coupe and finish with a generous drizzle of chili oil.
